values.goal: Produce one accepted critical-asset schedule for the complete asset denominator.
values.required_outcome: One accepted critical-asset schedule with provenance, ownership, licensing, trademark, and assignment dispositions. The asset validator proves every critical asset appears exactly once with an accepted disposition and redacted receipt.
authority_boundary: Issue completion is exactly acceptance of the one critical-asset schedule; source-specific checks are evidence inputs, not separately closeable results.
No adjacent sprint or provider authority
operator_constraints: No paid cloud or provider mutation
No secrets, legal instruments, auth codes, or recovery factors in Git
